title: Measuring Value Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a theoretical formalism for quantifying value alignment between AI systems and human values using Markov Decision Processes. It does not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze any aspect of religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
